description: What line_profiler timed in a process over a stretch (saved every 30 seconds while profiling, and as it's switched off).

at.description: When the stretch ended, in seconds since the epoch.

app.description: The process profiled: the host's, Baude's or Record's.

lines.description: Its lines that ran, the most time first (at most 200).

commit.description: The commit the process profiled runs (its first 12 characters), as it started.

wire.description: The wire's version the process profiled speaks.

picked.description: What its counts picked it to profile over the stretch, each with the count that picked it (none: named by telemetry_set, or the developers' pick).
